hypothesis.title: Day-of-the-Week Effects in Cryptocurrency Returns
hypothesis.statement: The mean daily return of an equal-weight crypto basket differs across weekdays.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: All six weekday-dummy coefficients are zero (equal mean return on every weekday).
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: At least one coefficient differs from zero (HAC joint Wald p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Weekday-dummy regression with Newey-West HAC errors and a joint Wald test
hypothesis.metric_name: HAC Wald chi-square (6 df) for equal weekday means
hypothesis.summary_findings: Wald chi2=10.70 (p=0.0983); best Sat 0.607%, worst Thu 0.010%.
